policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="rpcBody" value="@(context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true))" />
    

    
      

        
        

        

        
          
            
            
              @($"https://cosmoslab82658.documents.azure.com/dbs/governance/colls/mcp-canonical-map/docs")
              POST
              
                @("type=aad&ver=1.0&sig=" + (string)context.Variables["cosmosAadToken"])
              
              
                2018-12-31
              
              
                true
              
              
                true
              
              
                application/query+json
              
              @{
                var q = new JObject(
                  new JProperty("query",
                    "SELECT VALUE c.primary.name FROM c WHERE c.id = @id OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(c.aliases, @id)"),
                  new JProperty("parameters", new JArray(
                    new JObject(new JProperty("name", "@id"),
                                new JProperty("value", (string)context.Variables["requestedFqid"]))
                  ))
                );
                return q.ToString();
              }
            

            <set-variable name="canonicalTool" value="@{
              var resp = (IResponse)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("cosmosResp");
              if (resp == null || resp.StatusCode >= 400) {
                return (string)context.Variables["requestedTool"];
              }
              var body = resp.Body.As();
              var docs = body["Documents"] as JArray;
              if (docs == null || docs.Count == 0) {
                return (string)context.Variables["requestedTool"];
              }
              return docs[0]?.ToString() ?? (string)context.Variables["requestedTool"];
            }" />

            
          
        

        
          
            @{
              var body = (JObject)context.Variables["rpcBody"];
              body["params"]["name"] = (string)context.Variables["canonicalTool"];
              return body.ToString();
            }

outbound.choose:
<when condition="@(context.Response.StatusCode >= 200 && context.Response.StatusCode < 300)">

        <set-variable name="rpcResp" value="@(context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true))" />
        

        
          

            

            
              
                

                
                  @($"https://cosmoslab82658.documents.azure.com/dbs/governance/colls/mcp-canonical-map/docs")
                  POST
                  
                    @("type=aad&ver=1.0&sig=" + (string)context.Variables["cosmosAadToken"])
                  
                  
                    2018-12-31
                  
                  
                    true
                  
                  
                    true
                  
                  
                    application/query+json
                  
                  @{
                    var q = new JObject(
                      new JProperty("query",
                        "SELECT VALUE c.aliases FROM c WHERE c.canonical_server = @s OR EXISTS(SELECT VALUE m FROM m IN c.members WHERE m.server = @s)"),
                      new JProperty("parameters", new JArray(
                        new JObject(new JProperty("name", "@s"), new JProperty("value", "messy-mcp"))
                      ))
                    );
                    return q.ToString();
                  }
                

                <set-variable name="aliasDropCsv" value="@{
                  var resp = (IResponse)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("cosmosResp");
                  if (resp == null || resp.StatusCode >= 400) { return ""; }
                  var docs = resp.Body.As()["Documents"] as JArray;
                  if (docs == null) { return ""; }
                  var ids = new System.Collections.Generic.List();
                  foreach (var aliasArr in docs) {
                    if (aliasArr is JArray arr) {
                      foreach (var a in arr) { ids.Add(a.ToString()); }
                    }
                  }
                  return string.Join(",", ids);
                }" />

                
              
            

            <set-variable name="droppedCount" value="@{
              var dropCsv = (string)context.Variables["aliasDropCsv"];
              // "__none__" is the sentinel written by cache-store-value
              // when the real value would be empty (see above).
              if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dropCsv) || dropCsv == "__none__") { return 0; }
              var dropSet = new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet(
                  dropCsv.Split(','), System.StringComparer.Ordinal);

              var tools = (JArray)context.Variables["rpcResult"];
              var kept = new JArray();
              int dropped = 0;
              foreach (var t in tools) {
                var name = t["name"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                var fqid = "messy-mcp__" + name;
                if (dropSet.Contains(fqid)) { dropped++; continue; }
                kept.Add(t);
              }

              var resp = (JObject)context.Variables["rpcResp"];
              ((JObject)resp["result"])["tools"] = kept;
              return dropped;
            }" />

            
            @(((JObject)context.Variables["rpcResp"]).ToString())
            
              @(((int)context.Variables["droppedCount"]).ToString())
